scripts.predev: node scripts/clean-prisma-generated.cjs && npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://prisma:prisma@127.0.0.1:5432/dummy?schema=public prisma generate
scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-listen-port.mjs 3100 && concurrently -k -n pg,web -c magenta,green "node scripts/embedded-pg-serve.mjs" "node scripts/wait-embedded-ready.mjs && next dev -H localhost -p 3100 --webpack"
scripts.dev:turbo: node scripts/kill-listen-port.mjs 3100 && concurrently -k -n pg,web -c magenta,green "node scripts/embedded-pg-serve.mjs" "node scripts/wait-embedded-ready.mjs && next dev -H localhost -p 3100"
scripts.dev:lan: node scripts/kill-listen-port.mjs 3100 && concurrently -k -n pg,web -c magenta,green "node scripts/embedded-pg-serve.mjs" "node scripts/wait-embedded-ready.mjs && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3100 --webpack"
scripts.dev:lan:turbo: node scripts/kill-listen-port.mjs 3100 && concurrently -k -n pg,web -c magenta,green "node scripts/embedded-pg-serve.mjs" "node scripts/wait-embedded-ready.mjs && next dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p 3100"
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-prisma-generated.cjs && npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://prisma:prisma@127.0.0.1:5432/dummy?schema=public prisma generate && cross-env MSV_LENIENT_DB_BUILD=1 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://prisma:prisma@127.0.0.1:5432/dummy?schema=public NODE_ENV=production next build
scripts.railway:predeploy: prisma generate && prisma db push && prisma db seed
scripts.db:push: node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx prisma db push
scripts.db:push:prod: cross-env MSV_MERGE_PRODUCTION=1 node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed:prod: cross-env MSV_MERGE_PRODUCTION=1 node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:import-tax:prod: cross-env MSV_MERGE_PRODUCTION=1 node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx tsx scripts/sync-tax-json-to-db.ts
scripts.db:studio:prod: cross-env MSV_MERGE_PRODUCTION=1 node scripts/merged-env-run.cjs npx prisma studio
